topic: Mammoths lived when the pyramids were built
script: Woolly mammoths were still alive when the Great Pyramid of Giza was built. The last ones lived on Wrangel Island, off the coast of Siberia. They died out there about 4,000 years ago. Woolly mammoths were about the size of African elephants. Their curving tusks could grow to around 4 meters long. Frozen mammoths have been found in Siberia with hair and skin still intact.
